title: Dawns Watch
order_note: Sorted by recording id: C (cinematics), M (in-engine cutscenes), T (gameplay transmissions); unit barks follow their trigger group. Interleaving of C/M/T is not confirmed.

lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: The Scourge have found us! Argent Dawn, to arms!

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: I knew this would happen!
lines.raw: ["Angry" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]I knew this would happen![/"Angry"]

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Lord Tyrosus! These Forsaken are under my protection.

lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: Leonid, thank the Light you've returned! Then these undead...
lines.raw: ["Surprised" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]Leonid, thank the Light you've returned! Then these undead...[/"Surprised"]

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: Are the same as I am. And they are under attack from the Scarlet Crusade.

lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: Those fanatics must be stopped.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Do you truly expect us to believe there’s any difference between you?

lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: We were once all Knights of the Silver Hand. But those who sought vengeance for Lordaeron twisted the order into the Scarlet Crusade.

lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: We who held fast to the true teachings of the Light left and formed the Argent Dawn.

lines.speaker: Lord Tyrosus
lines.text: Alas, we are few in number. The Crusade grow strong within their monastery, and we have little hope of defeating them in battle.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: This monastery... could you lead us to it?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: You may not have the forces to lay siege to the Crusade’s stronghold, but the Forsaken do.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You would have us fight their war for them?

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It's our war as well. The Scarlet Crusade is sure to strike the Undercity again.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: I will lead you to them. I doubt Lady Sylvanas would trust anyone else from the Argent Dawn.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: You'll be lucky if she trusts you.
lines.raw: ["Squint" type=quad v2=0.5 v3=0.5 easein=0.45 easeout=0.45]You'll be lucky if she trusts you.[/"Squint"]

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: Then it’s settled. Light guide our path.

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The Argent Dawn had to garrison in ogre territory. We may have to fight our way up the hill.

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Leonid! The ogres took our patrols prisoner! The fort is under attack!

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: What?! Then there's no time to spare! We must rescue the others and break the siege!

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: By the Light's grace, we're not too late! The fort's gates still hold!

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: They won't for much longer. We have to end this siege now!

lines.speaker: Leonid
lines.text: The siege is broken, and the rest of the ogres will scatter into the hills. Let's head into the fort.

lines.speaker: Garek
lines.text: It's time to let Lady Sylvanas know what we've learned.

lines.speaker: Anya
lines.text: Do not expect a warm homecoming, Leonid. Not all Forsaken are as forgiving as I am.

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Ready for action!

lines.speaker: Priest
lines.text: I am your servant.

lines.speaker: Footman
lines.text: Say the word.

lines.speaker: Rifleman
lines.text: Locked and loaded!
